title: Generalizations of the Christoffel-Darboux formula and congruences involving Apéry-like numbers
summary: In this paper, we first extend the Christoffel-Darboux formula for orthogonal polynomials to general three-term recurrence sequences, and then investigate the identities and congruences for $g_n(x)$ and $v_n(x)$ given by \begin{align*} &g_0(x)=1,\ g_1(x)=\frac{x+1}2,\ (n+1)^2g_{n+1}(x)=\Big(2n(n+1)+\frac{x+1}2\Big)g_n(x)-n^2g_{n-1}(x)\ (n\ge 1), \\&v_0(x)=1,\ v_1(x)=x,\ (n+1)^3v_{n+1}(x)=(2n+1)(n(n+1)+x)v_n(x)-n^3v_{n-1}(x)\ (n\ge 1).\end{align*}
